en: Black-and-white view of a landscaped park with a curving gravel path bordered by low wooden fencing and iron railings. On the left stands a small rectangular stone tower that looks like a medieval ruin, partly surrounded by lawn and trees. In the center and right are dense shrubs and trees climbing up a slope with a stone retaining wall, while on the far right a grand terrace with balustrade and stairs rises from the garden, framed by large leafy plants. In the distant background, a tall chimney stack is visible above the treeline. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
